user.title: Add gaming PC
user.description: Select a gaming PC that currently advertises itself over MQTT. HA MQTT discovery does not need to be enabled.

abort.no_devices_found: No new gaming PC found. Make sure the Windows agent is running and publishing to SmartHouse/Gaming/+/discovery, then try again.

menu.title: Parental control
menu.description: Configure monitoring and connection settings for this PC.

limits.title: Restrictions and schedule
limits.description: Set time limits using the sliders on the device page. Reset options disable the selected limit (weekend reset uses the weekday limit). Start/end: HH:MM, equal means all day.

update_settings.title: Windows update settings
update_settings.description: Set a trusted HTTPS URL to an approved version catalog, or leave blank to disable remote update controls.

mqtt_settings.title: MQTT configuration

tracked_apps.title: Tracked applications

add_app.title: Add detected application
add_app.description: Current foreground identity: {candidate}. Give it a display name for the future Active game entity. Keep the same application focused until saving. No Windows configuration is changed.

rename_app.title: Rename tracked application
rename_app.description: Change only the display name; the process identity and future statistics key remain unchanged.

remove_app.title: Remove tracked application
remove_app.description: Remove this mapping from Home Assistant only; existing Windows configuration is untouched.

error.invalid_catalog: Enter an HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment.
error.no_live_candidate: No fresh uniquely identifiable application. Open it on the selected PC and try again. Java needs a safe main class or JAR/module.
error.candidate_changed: The foreground application changed or its sample expired. Reopen Add application while the original application is focused.
error.configuration_changed: The HA application list changed while this form was open. Reopen the flow before editing.
error.invalid_application: Invalid, duplicate, or already removed application mapping/name.
error.no_tracked_apps: No HA-managed applications to modify yet.

abort.invalid_app_configuration: Stored tracked applications are invalid; no changes were made.
